subject: CS241
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selections offered high-quality, directly relevant content for all topics. For Arabic, coverage was good for most topics, but a suitable video for 'Systolic Arrays for Neural Networks' could not be found as all candidates were either irrelevant or failed hard gates. For 'Cache Coherence' and 'Superscalar Architectures', the selected Arabic videos covered key aspects of the topic, representing the best available options.

coverage.note: Only one candidate passed the view count gate.
No single video perfectly covered both Superscalar and VLIW; selected the best available for the Superscalar concept.
All candidates failed the relevance gate, focusing on general neural networks or programming arrays, not the specific hardware architecture.

videos.title: MESI Cache Coherence Protocol | Vasileios Trigonakis
videos.filter_reason: This EPFL lecture is perfectly on-topic, clearly explaining the MESI protocol states and transitions with high academic quality and significant viewership.

videos.title: Superscalar vs VLIW - Georgia Tech - HPCA: Part 3
videos.filter_reason: From Georgia Tech via Udacity, this video provides a direct, concise, and high-quality comparison of Superscalar and VLIW architectures.

videos.title: Interconnection networks in Distributed Memory architectures
videos.channel: Introduction to Parallel Programming in OpenMP
videos.topic_ar: شبكات الربط والتوجيه في معمارية الحاسوب
videos.filter_reason: This NPTEL video provides a solid academic overview of various interconnection network topologies within the context of computer architecture, making it highly relevant.

videos.title: TPUs, systolic arrays, and bfloat16: accelerate your deep learning | Kaggle
videos.filter_reason: This Kaggle video is ideal as it explains systolic arrays directly in the context of their most important modern application: TPUs for deep learning.

videos.title: Quantum Computing Expert Explains One Concept in 5 Levels of Difficulty | WIRED
videos.filter_reason: The WIRED '5 Levels of Difficulty' format is exceptionally pedagogical, making it perfect for university students to build a solid understanding from fundamentals to expert-level concepts.

videos.title: 11. Snooping Protocols
videos.filter_reason: This was the only eligible Arabic video; it explains the foundational concept of snooping protocols, which is a prerequisite for understanding MESI.

videos.title: Design SuperScalar (in order issue in order completion)
videos.filter_reason: This is the best available option, providing a clear whiteboard explanation of Superscalar processor design, a core part of the topic, with good viewership.

videos.title: CSE415 - High Performance computing - Interconnection Networks
videos.topic_ar: شبكات الربط والتوجيه في معمارية الحاسوب
videos.filter_reason: This is a university lecture from a High Performance Computing course that directly and comprehensively covers interconnection networks in Arabic.

videos.title: الكمبيوتر الكمي | Quantum Computer
videos.filter_reason: A well-structured and detailed explainer that covers the core concepts of quantum computing with significant reach and good production quality for the Arabic language.
